{{Top}}
'''Class IV moon''' was the designation given to any small, natural satellite in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Class IV [[Moon/Legends|moons]] were roughly one hundred and twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in diameter.

The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] was said to be the size of a Class IV moon.
